title: Create: Direct Chute: Andesite Age
description: Retextures the direct chute similar to the block of andesite alloy
body:
A resource pack that changes the texture of the direct chute from the [Create: Direct Chute](https://modrinth.com/project/wKK8BgBy) addon to a grey/andesite one.
